name: Six Clip Velocity
summary: Turn six videos into a 23-second velocity edit with speed ramps, vertical blur cuts, a white flash, kinetic subtitles and a fade to black, over bundled music, as editable video clips.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original clip placement service (as Four Photo Reveal and Camera Shutter Dump use), clip retiming, public clip effects, motion graphics and Audio overlays; no extra tools to install. Verified on macOS in Selects Staging and a local develop build on 2026-10-01: saved Draft readback and export. Windows is built to the kit rules but not yet verified on a real Windows machine.
